1.Name: tank
1.Description: Tank: Durable and well-suited to fighting on the frontline. Tanks often possess protective and damage reducing skills.

2.Name: assassin
2.Description: Assassin: Fast and agile, able to effortlessly strike in multiple locations and take out important enemy targets.

3.Name: continuous output
3.Description: Continuous Damage: Deals stable and persistent damage to enemies.

4.Name: burst output
4.Description: Burst Damage: Deals infrequent but fatal damage. Especially effective against fragile targets.

5.Name: group attack
5.Description: Area of Effect: Deals damage to multiple targets at once.

6.Name: weaken
6.Description: Debuff: Decreases the performance and attributes of enemy targets.

7.Name: control
7.Description: Control: Disrupts the flow of battles, preventing enemies from moving or using their skills normally.

8.Name: treatment
8.Description: Regen: Restores allied heroes' hit points.

9.Name: gain
9.Description: Buff: Increases the performance and attributes of allied heroes.
